name: Government Medical College, Kasaragod
tagline: Kasaragod district’s government tertiary referral and teaching hospital
summary: District tertiary referral and teaching hospital at Ukkinadka, Kasaragod. Began as a COVID hospital in 2020; first MBBS batch started October 3, 2025 while the main hospital block remains under…
description: Government Medical College, Kasaragod is the state-run medical college and principal tertiary-referral institution serving Kasaragod district. The campus and academic block are at Ukkinadka (Badiadka panchayat); the institution also uses the existing General Hospital in Kasaragod town as its teaching hospital while the main hospital block is completed.

The college began functioning during the COVID-19 pandemic (April 6, 2020) with inpatient services in a partially completed academic block and later opened outpatient, diagnostics and pharmacy services. The college received affiliation and NMC permission for a 50-seat MBBS intake; classes for the inaugural MBBS batch started on October 3, 2025.

The full Medical College Hospital block at Ukkinadka is planned as a much larger facility (the institutional documentation envisages a 500-bed hospital when complete). Construction, funding and technical approvals have progressed in stages; several projects and MEP/finishing works remained outstanding as of the latest government documentation.

For patients and visitors the site functions primarily as a teaching and outpatient hub at present; many tertiary inpatient services continue to be provided through the designated Medical College Hospital (General Hospital) in Kasaragod town until the Ukkinadka hospital block is fully operational.
highlights: Academic campus and nursing college at Ukkinadka (Badiadka panchayat).
NMC permission and first MBBS class begun — 50 MBBS seats (academic year 2025–26).
Started as a 200-bed COVID facility in April 2020 and later provided OPD and limited diagnostics.
Main hospital block under construction; institutional plan envisages a 500-bed Medical College Hospital when complete.
General Hospital, Kasaragod renamed/designed as the Medical College Hospital to meet teaching-hospital requirements while hospital block is completed.

sections.heading: Background
body: The project to establish a Government Medical College for Kasaragod was part of Kerala’s policy to ensure at least one government medical college in each district. Work on the Ukkinadka campus began in the 2010s; the academic block later doubled as a COVID-19 facility and opened limited services in 2020.

State health publications and the Directorate of Medical Education provide project details, staffing plans and the phased funding and technical approvals that guide completion of the hospital block and residential facilities.

sections.heading: Academic and clinical services
body: The college is affiliated to the Kerala University of Health Sciences and obtained necessary permissions to admit 50 MBBS students; classes for the first batch started on 3 October 2025. Departments, faculty deputations and junior residents were mobilised in 2025 to support teaching needs.

Clinical services at the Ukkinadka campus currently include OPD clinics across multiple specialties, laboratory services, pharmacy and basic imaging. More advanced tertiary services (and inpatient capacity beyond the existing temporary beds) are expected to shift to the completed hospital block at Ukkinadka once construction and regulatory clearances are finished.

sections.heading: What visitors and patients should expect
body: Today the campus functions mainly as an academic centre with outpatient and limited inpatient services. For complex tertiary inpatient care many patients still use the Medical College Hospital (the old General Hospital in Kasaragod town) that has been designated to meet teaching-hospital norms while the Ukkinadka hospital block is completed.

The institutional documentation outlines equipment and staffing upgrades in progress and lists priority works (fire safety, HT connection, MEP and hospital finishes) necessary before full hospital operations and expansion of inpatient services.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Confirm the specific clinical service or department before travelling: OPD availability, diagnostic services and admission capacity can change while construction continues. The academic campus address is Ukkinadka, Mundayathadukka–Puthige Road, Ukkinadka PO, Kasaragod 671552.

Ukkinadka campus is rural; the designated teaching hospital (the renamed General Hospital, Kasaragod) is in Kasaragod town and is approximately 25–30 km away — news reports and official notes cite journeys of roughly 50 minutes between the two sites depending on route and traffic.

latest.text: Kerala Health Minister states the Kasaragod medical college project will be completed within a year, addressing long-standing delays in the hospital block — government aims to finish remaining works and commissioning.

Comprehensive institutional document published by the Health & Family Welfare Department (Government of Kerala) summarises facilities, progress, staffing, and envisages a 500‑bed Medical College Hospital when fully complete.

Classes for the first MBBS batch at Government Medical College, Kasaragod began on October 3, 2025 after NMC permission and affiliation; initial students attended at the Ukkinadka academic campus while teaching-hospital arrangements use the General Hospital in Kasaragod town.

visitorInfo.bestTime: year-round (institutional services operate continuously; confirm specific clinics before travel)
visitorInfo.howToReach: The academic campus is at Ukkinadka, Badiadka panchayat (Ukkinadka PO 671552). Ukkinadka is rural and accessed by road from Kasaragod town (about 25–30 km; journey times ~50 minutes reported). The designated teaching hospital sits in Kasaragod town — confirm which campus/OPD you need before travelling.
etiquette: Confirm department/OPD timings and whether the required service operates at Ukkinadka campus or at the Medical College Hospital in Kasaragod town before you travel.
If visiting for admissions or academic matters bring original ID, admission documents and appointment letters; administrative offices operate from the academic block.
Road travel between Ukkinadka and Kasaragod town can take nearly an hour; plan transport accordingly and allow extra time for transfers.
Respect patient privacy and ward visiting rules; medical campuses often restrict photography and require prior permission for official visits.
